meta.title: Delete Conversation
meta.description: Delete a conversation with an optional cascade into its associated memory. Soft delete and recycle bin, audit trail, batch rate limits, and per-session rollback.

section.label: Conversation Deletion
section.title: Conversation Deletion
section.subtitle: Recycle bin, batch deletion and audit trail.

dialog.bodyOne: “{title}” will be removed from the session list.
dialog.bodyMany: {count} conversations will be removed from the session list.
dialog.modeSoftHint: Files stay on disk and can be restored from the recycle bin.
dialog.modeHardHint: Moves the session log out of the live store. Recoverable until the recycle-bin entry is purged.
dialog.memoryLabel: Also delete this conversation’s associated memory
dialog.memoryHint: Off by default. Memory entries are counted before you confirm.
dialog.memoryCount: {count} associated memory entries will be moved to the recycle bin
dialog.memoryNone: No associated memory entries were found
dialog.hardWarning: Type DELETE to confirm permanent deletion.
dialog.batchWarning: Type the number {count} to confirm this batch.
dialog.memoryDeleted: {count} memory entries moved to the recycle bin.

trash.title: Recycle bin
trash.confirmPurge: Permanently delete this entry? This cannot be undone.
trash.auditEmpty: No deletion has been recorded yet.

batch.title: Batch deletion
batch.hint: Select conversations to delete. Deletion is per-conversation atomic; a failure rolls that conversation back.
